notes.subject: kuma-tigɛmaba
notes.rationale: השמיעיני is feminine singular — the speaker addresses the woman directly: 'cause me to hear your voice.'

notes.subject: i kan nin di n mɛn
notes.rationale: Imperative summons asking the beloved to let her voice be heard.

notes.subject: bɛ tulo la
notes.rationale: מקשיבים literally 'pricking up the ears'; rendered with the Bambara idiom for attentive listening.

translation: I min bɛ nakɔw kɔnɔ tensɛn, namaraw bɛ tulo la i kan ma; i kan nin di n mɛn!

tokens.gloss: i kan nin di n mɛn
